notes.title: Update Patch 9.8 (Buffs and QoL)
notes.content:
Heroes of the Seasons 9.8

- During camping, "Proceed" button will now ask for confirmation to avoid misclicks.

Peytr, the Demon Child buff: 

- Both of his offensive skills "Disembowel" and "Banefire" won't remove Sleep state on targets.
- "Nightmare" will now target 4 random enemies instead of 3.

Mikaye, the Witch and Elrond, the Arcanist buff:

- Mikaye's skills "Arcanopulse" and "Blazing Ender", and Elrond's skills "Glacial Pierce" and "Lance of Ragnarok" now have 400% damage multiplier, from 300%.

Accessory reworks:

"Party Horn"

- Now costs 25000 Vyse from 15000
- Now gives +25 Max HP from +40
- Now gives wearer bonus +15 chance to counter physical attacks.

"Crown of the Holidays":

- Now gives wearer bonus +7 to all stats.

"Milk":

- Evasions bonus increased to 12% from 10%.

"Orange Pencil":

- Bonus experience increased to 50% from 25%.

Tooltip clarity update:

- Offensive skills now have "(Magical-type)" on their descriptions if they're the type of skills that are reflected when enemies have a reflect buff. If offensive skills don't have "(Magical-type)" on their descriptions, it means they deal attack-based damage which won't be reflected, but instead will be counter-attacked by enemies who have "Danger Stance" (counter-attack) buff.

Bosses' "Shattered Reactions" skill nerf:

- Cooldown increased to 3 turns from 2 turns. Allowing players a wider opening to inflict states on bosses.

Victory Aftermath update:

- Victory screen will now show additional information such as damage dealt, damage taken, deaths, minimum turns, and a total score or rating. (Credits to Cheddare for this code)

notes.title: A Hellish Update is now available!
notes.content:
Heroes of the Seasons 9.0: A Devilish Holiday Update!

More Cameo characters, alongside some demonic beings, join the fray! Find out who's responsible for this new threat that looms over Utania.



- New unlockable stages:

Cameo+ Stage (Unlocked by beating Cameo Stage)

Hell Stage (Unlocked by beating Cameo+ Stage)

Heaven or Hell (Unlocked by beating Hell Stage)



(New Steam Achievements for beating each new stages!)



- New shopkeeper "Nigaru" for new stages brings powerful new items and equipment.

- New item on the "Item Shop": "Spicy Treats" Draws enemy aggro to user.

- New awesome background arts by Berry B. (in and out of battles)



Old Saves still work for this update, but please follow these instructions to refresh your save, allowing it to

recognize the new content:



1. Choose your mercenaries and select any stage.

2. Visit Home, then exit Home.

3. Return to the mercenary selection.

4. Save.



After doing these steps, your save file should be refreshed. You will now be able to unlock Cameo+ Stage after beating the older Cameo Stage, or if you've already beaten the older Cameo Stage, Cameo+ Stage will already be available on Stage Select. 



Cameo+ Boss Characters:

Santa Claws from Apho's "Christmas Cat-astrophe"

Caroline from Muyoko-Honey-Bandicoot's "Skybound Dreamers Gaiden" 

and Clyfford from Muyoko-Honey-Bandicoot's "Fanuvania Newfound Coven"

Zander and Anaya from Frostnoble's "Blade of Acrimony: Wish of the West"

Van from Cheddare's "Remnants of Twilight"

Lilac and Mahlat from Remi-Chan's "Fantasia"

David from Starmage's "A Sun-Kissed Fantasy"

Misha from Starmage's "Stellar Bewitching"

Kit and Slippy from Starmage and Berry's "Whimsical Misadventures of Cinderella"

Mike from Erif/JoTerra's "Shadows of the Earth: The Vrila'an Legend"

notes.title: Small QoL Patch
notes.content:
A small patch comes to Heroes of the Seasons!

Changelog:

- The scaling of magical abilities has been increased from 200% to 300%.
- The scaling of some mercenaries' physical attacks has been increased.
- New Keyboard/Gamepad Config plugin that's more compatible with the rest of the plugins.
- Modes are now called "Stage".
- Jam Mode, Normal Mode, and Crisis Mode have been renamed to 1st Stage, 2nd Stage, and 3rd Stage. (Reasons for renaming: To make it clear that playing each mode progresses the story, not just the difficulty.)

notes.title: New Lategame Consumables
notes.content:
This update adds new consumable items you can buy at the Gift Shop after beating Armageddon Mode.

(Changelog: 8.0)
- Snowman Sneeze (Max: 5) will now be purchasable at the Gift Shop after beating Armageddon Mode.
- New Item: Healthy Burger (Max: 4) Consumes to buff the entire party's ATK, INT, DEF, M.Def, and AGI for 3 turns. (Available at Gift Shop after beating Armageddon Mode)
- New Item: Fairy Dust (Max: 2) Consume to deal non-elemental damage to all enemies and remove their Reflect and Counter Attack states. (Is given 2 Fairy Dust at the start of Cameo Mode ONCE, but will be available for purchase anytime at the Gift Shop after beating Cameo Mode-Nightmare difficulty)

IMPORTANT: If you have a save at the PUB (Post Armageddon) before this update, please refresh the screen at the Mercenary Select Screen so the patched items will be present at the Gift Shop immediately. You can refresh this by pressing the "Cancel" button during the Mercenary Select Screen. This is needed cause the engine doesn't seem to update the choices with an old save, but will be updated once the call processing of the mercenary select screen is refreshed.

notes.title: Enemy mobs nerf and more!
notes.content:
I have received some feedback that the enemy mobs were too tanky and tedious to finish back to back (Normal mode onwards), so this patch aims to fix that and make fighting the mobs smoother for the player for a more enjoyable experience.

Changelog (7.5):
- Enemy mobs from Normal mode onwards now have their Max HP reduced.
- Enemy mobs from Normal mode onwards now give increased EXP.
- Nuke consumable items such as  Flare, Discharge, and Magnum Presents have increased base damage output by 50.
- Poison and Burn DOT states have increased damage per turn. Poison from 0.5 of INT to 1.2 of INT. Burn from 0.8 of INT to 1.8 of INT. Note: This applies to both players and enemies.

That would be all! Thank you so much! And please keep the feedback coming to help give players a better experience playing this game. ^^

notes.title: Supports and Tank Mercenary buff patch!
notes.content:
After receiving feedback from Berry's amazing and detailed Mercenary tier list, it is clear to us that Delilah and Helena are lackluster in the supporting role. So this update focuses on buffing them so that players will still have a reason to pick them over other support mercenaries. Quint's tanking abilities are also lackluster compared to most tank mercenaries, so he is also receiving an overhaul in his kit that makes him more fun to play and stronger as a tank.

Delilah
- Lunar Blessings now grant 10% MP regen per turn (From 5% MP regen)
- Lunar Blessings now removes stat debuffs on all allies.

Helena
- Lover's Oath now removes stat debuffs on the targeted ally.
- Wedding Bells now removes the "Superior Mind Control" state on allies.

Removing stat debuffs is exclusive to both Delilah and Helena, giving them the upper hand over other support mercenaries in that regard.

Quint
- Rigid Swing is now a regular Arcane Damage attack on one single enemy.
- Unholy Light no longer taunts enemies. In addition to being able to drain HP, Unholy Light now also grants Quint a Reflect state for 1 turn, and a shield that nullifies all damage once.
- Divine Oath now taunts enemies for 3 turns. Also grants a shield that absorbs 150 damage.

Quint's original kit is not very intuitive I must admit. So I updated his kit to be more straightforward and intuitive, among giving him more viability is a tank. Making his reflect state and nullify shield separate states will also help with his tanking abilities.

QOL Updates and fixes:
- Choosing "Start Defending Christmas" when you're in the mercenary screen with a full party will now ask for a confirmation to avoid accidental clicks that bring the player immediately to the mode select screen.
